description: Redesign LoginScreen.tsx to match premium Apple HIG / Airbnb quality with hero artwork carousel, statistics cards, improved branding, and future-ready authentication buttons. All existing business logic (Google OAuth, Dev Login, Guest mode, SignUp navigation) must be preserved exactly as-is.
steps: Rewrite mobile/src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.tsx with the following visual structure while keeping ALL existing state, hooks, effects, and handler functions unchanged:

1. HERO CAROUSEL SECTION (top ~40% of screen): Create a horizontal FlatList-based artwork carousel using the existing authBackgroundMedia from useAppSelector((state) => state.app). Display large centered artwork images with partial previous/next artwork visible (use snapToInterval, horizontal, pagingEnabled=false with item width ~80% of screen width). Add pagination dots below carousel. Auto-scroll with setInterval every 4 seconds using Animated API.

2. BRANDING SECTION: Large centered logo using Feather 'aperture' icon (size 56). Below: 'ArtNepalaya' in bold 28pt. Below: 'Discover . Share . Inspire' tagline. Below: Short description text 'Nepal's premier platform for artists and art lovers'.

3. STATISTICS CARDS: Three side-by-side rounded cards with soft shadows: '18K+ Artists', '75K+ Artworks', 'Made in Nepal'. Use lightColors.surface background, rounded corners (16), subtle border, centered text.

4. AUTHENTICATION BUTTONS: Primary 'Continue with Google' - filled red (#FF3B30) button, full width, rounded (14), Google icon (Feather 'mail'). Secondary 'Sign up with Google' - outlined button with red border, Google icon. Preserve existing handleGoogleLogin and handleSignUp logic exactly.
5. TERMS TEXT: Small centered text 'By continuing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy' with subtle color.
6. FOOTER: 'Built for Nepal's Creative Community' centered at bottom.

7. DEV LOGIN SECTION: Keep existing Developer Login section exactly as current implementation but move it below all auth buttons. Clearly label 'Developer Login (QA Only)'. Preserve handleDevLogin, devLoading, devError state exactly.
8. SKIP BUTTON: Keep existing handleSkip as 'Continue as Guest' link below auth buttons.
9. ANIMATIONS: Use React Native Animated API only (no reanimated). Fade-in on mount for branding section, scale animation on button press, carousel auto-scroll.
10. REMOVE AnimatedBackground usage since the new design has a white/light background with the carousel as the hero visual instead of the full-screen background image.
11. Use lightColors from theme/colors.ts for the redesign (white background design). The current dark overlay design is being replaced with a clean light theme.
12. Ensure responsive layout using Dimensions and percentage-based sizing that works on Android, iOS, tablets, and small phones.
acceptance_criteria: LoginScreen renders without errors with all existing imports resolving correctly
Google OAuth flow (handleGoogleLogin, useIdTokenAuthRequest, response handling) is preserved exactly
Developer Login (handleDevLogin) continues to work with existing API call to /auth/admin-login
Guest mode (handleSkip with SecureStore and setGuest dispatch) is preserved
WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession() call is preserved at module level
registerForPushNotifications is still called after successful auth
fetchAuthConfig dispatch on mount is preserved
No new npm dependencies introduced - only using React Native Animated, StyleSheet, existing @expo/vector-icons
Visual output matches premium Apple HIG / Airbnb quality design with proper spacing, rounded components, and soft shadows
verification: Read the final LoginScreen.tsx and verify all handler functions (handleGoogleLogin, handleAuthSuccess, handleDevLogin, handleSkip, handleSignUp) have identical logic to the original
Verify all imports resolve to existing modules (no new packages)
Verify the component exports as named export { LoginScreen }
Verify WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession() is called at module level
Verify Google.useIdTokenAuthRequest hook is configured with same client IDs
